description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of entity types identified in a biomedical context, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and its relative proportion. The chart is divided into 18 distinct slices, each labeled with its entity type and percentage value. The largest segment is "Chemical," colored blue, accounting for 32%. The second largest is "Protein," colored orange, at 15%. Following these are "DNA" (green, 6%), "Chemical Family" (red, 5%), "Disease" (purple, 5%), and "Cell Type" (brown, 5%). Other segments include "Drug" (pink, 4%), "Frequency" (gray, 3%), "Cell Line" (yellow, 3%), "Dosage" (cyan, 3%), "Strength" (dark blue, 2%), "Form" (light green, 2%), "Gene Or Gene Product" (dark green, 2%), "Route" (purple, 2%), "Reason" (light purple, 2%), "Disease Or Phenotypic Feature" (light gray, 1%), "RNA" (light blue, 1%), "Sequence Variant" (light pink, 1%), "Modifier" (light green, 1%), "Organism Taxon" (light red, 1%), "Duration" (light orange, 1%), and "Composite Mention" (light purple, 1%). The chart includes percentage labels directly within each slice and does not use a separate legend, though the labels are positioned around the perimeter for clarity. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with "Chemical" and moving clockwise.
